description: Ministry of Roads & Highways - The National Throughfres  (User fee) Regulations No. 1 of 2020
reasoning: This gazette content consists of regulations made by the Minister of Roads & Highways under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It establishes legal frameworks for user fees on national highways, specifies payment methods (manual and electronic), outlines procedures for toll collection, and creates regulatory requirements for E-tag users. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation that create binding legal requirements.
